methodologyNotes: 13 notable cordless stick vacuums selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set. Seeds from the brief (Dyson V15 Detect, V12 Detect Slim, Gen5detect, Tineco Pure One S15, Floor One S7, Shark Stratos, Detect Pro, Samsung Bespoke Jet AI, LG CordZero A9, Roborock Flexi Pro, Eufy Clean S1 Pro) were evaluated. Product lineup adjustments: (1) Eufy Clean S1 Pro was identified as a robot vacuum (Eufy S1 Pro Omni), not a cordless stick — excluded and replaced with Dyson V15s Detect Submarine and Tineco Pure ONE Station, both verifiable cordless sticks with 2024-2025 releases. (2) The Samsung Bespoke Jet reviewed is the standard model (Bespoke Jet); the 'Bespoke Jet AI' branding was announced but at time of research no dedicated review with verified specs was accessible — the standard Bespoke Jet is listed with a note. (3) Roborock 'Flexi Pro' could not be confirmed as an active US SKU (all us.roborock.com product URLs for 'flexi-pro' returned 404); replaced with Roborock H60 Hub Ultra and Roborock H60 Ultra, both verifiable 2025-2026 US models with accessible manufacturer pages. (4) LG CordZero A9 US product pages returned 404 across all URL variants tried; included with null price and provenance note. (5) Shark Stratos (IX141H) is confirmed discontinued at SharkNinja.com US (product URL 404, now replaced by PowerDetect line); included as a still-purchased 2022-era model with price from vacuumwars.com aggregate. (6) Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty added as the 2025 Shark flagship that directly replaces the Detect Pro/Stratos class. Primary source: vacuumwars.com (independent, stated no-sponsorship policy, owns all reviewed units) for suction AW, runtime, dustbin, weight, filtration, display, self-empty, price across most models. Manufacturer pages (us.roborock.com, dyson.com redirects) for Roborock H60 models. Key conversions: 240 AW Dyson V15 = manufacturer 240 AW; suction_pa for cordless stick vacuums is not universally published — AW (air watts) is the dominant published spec in this category. suction_pa is set to null for models where Pa is not in the verified sources; AW is noted in provenance. specKeys chosen for buyer comparison: suction_pa (Pa, official maximum; null where Pa not published by manufacturer/reviewer), runtime_min (max runtime in minutes, official), dustbin_l (dustbin capacity in liters), weight_lb (handle/body weight in lbs, as used by vacuumwars), self_empty (bool, whether a self-empty dock is included or available as bundle), display (string — 'LCD', 'LED', or 'none'), filtration (string, primary filtration type), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY string). priceUsd = US MSRP or current list price in USD for base/reference configuration noted in priceNote. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all sources.

products.name: Ultenic U16 Flex
products.priceNote: No US price (USD) could be sourced verbatim. The Amazon US product page for this exact model (dp/B0CZNTRLJB, accessed 2026-07-07) showed "No featured offers available" with no dollar figure for the U16 Flex (the EUR figures on the page belonged to other 'similar items' carousels, not this product). The official US ultenic.com product page was unreachable, returning HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) across ~20 retries. The Ultenic UK manufacturer page lists this model at £159.99 (reduced from £219.99), but that is GBP and cannot populate a US MSRP. Set to null per methodology (null over guess).
products.provenance: Fetched the official Ultenic UK manufacturer product page for the U16 Flex (uk.ultenic.com) as the primary source because the US ultenic.com product page was unreachable (HTTP 429 across ~20 retries). Its Specifications table verbatim confirms Model Number "U16 Flex", Working Voltage 29.6 V, Noise Level 80 dB, Product Dimensions 121.5*14.2*21.5 cm and Capacity 950 Millilitres; runtime is stated repeatedly as "Runtime: 60 minutes" / "up to 60 minutes"; filtration is a "Six-Layer Filtration System"; the display is described as a screen consolidating controls, mode, battery status and error alerts; and emptying is manual one-touch with only a Charging Rack/wall mount included (no auto-empty dock), so self_empty=false. The Amazon US retailer listing (dp/B0CZNTRLJB) corroborates Model Name "U16 Flex", the 60-minute runtime ("Battery Life 60 minutes", "Runtime 1 hour"), an "LED Display", a 6-Layer/6-stage HEPA filtration system, and Included Components of U16 Flex/Charging Rack/Crevice Tool/Charger/HEPA*2/Cleaning Brush (no self-empty station). NULLED: suction_pa — the sources give three irreconcilable figures (the UK page states both "45KPa" and "50KPa"; Amazon states both "50Kpa" and "55Kpa"); dustbin_l — the manufacturer spec table says 950 mL (0.95 L) while Amazon's structured Capacity field says 1.2 L and its marketing bullet says 1.5 L, unreconcilable; weight_lb — the only published weight is "Item Weight 2.7 kg", which is the packaged weight (the 9.84x9.06x4.88 in box cannot hold the 121.5 cm assembled vacuum) and not the body weight this specKey requires; release/releaseDate — no launch year appears on either fetched page. Runtime_min=60, self_empty=false, display=LED and filtration=6-Layer Filtration survive verification (4 of 8 spec keys), and the model identity "U16 Flex" is confirmed verbatim on both fetched pages. Re-fetch on 2026-07-09 reconfirmed every surviving value and the null decisions with no changes.
